prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1222; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Claimant reports their vehicle was struck while stopped in a marked space. Other driver's vehicle has been identified and their insurer notified. Photos requested from the claimant.

Entry 2: Claimant called to report a shoulder injury sustained during the impact, describing pain when raising the right arm. Claimant has not retained an attorney and is handling the claim directly. Advised claimant of the medical documentation needed and suggested they seek evaluation from a physician as soon as possible.

Entry 3: Received photos of both vehicles showing rear bumper damage on the claimant's car and front damage on the other vehicle. Reviewed the scene diagram provided by the other driver. Statements from both parties are consistent regarding the position of the vehicles at impact.

Entry 4: Claimant provided a copy of the initial medical visit summary noting a shoulder strain and a referral for imaging. Explained the process for submitting medical bills and wage loss documentation. Claimant indicated they are not currently working full-time and will provide employer verification.

Entry 5: Followed up with the claimant regarding the status of the imaging appointment. Claimant reports ongoing shoulder discomfort but improving with prescribed physical therapy. Repair estimate for the claimant's vehicle has been received and reviewed. File remains open pending medical records and the final liability determination.
